items.exampleEn: Some phone addicts check their screens every few minutes.
items.exampleZh: 有些手機成癮者每隔幾分鐘就看一次螢幕。

items.exampleEn: Flu is very infectious, especially in crowded places.
items.exampleZh: 流感的傳染力很強，尤其在擁擠的地方。

items.exampleEn: Whales must come up to the surface because their respiratory organs need air.
items.exampleZh: 鯨魚必須浮上水面，因為牠們的呼吸器官需要空氣。

items.exampleEn: The bruise on his leg turned from purple to yellow over a week.
items.exampleZh: 他腿上的瘀青在一週內從紫色變成黃色。

items.exampleEn: The word chemotherapy is made from 'chemical' and 'therapy'.
items.exampleZh: chemotherapy 這個字由「chemical」和「therapy」兩個字組成。

items.exampleEn: Scientists kept the infected mosquitoes in a separate room of the lab.
items.exampleZh: 科學家把受感染的蚊子關在實驗室的另一個房間。

items.exampleEn: The farmer worked until exhaustion to bring in the harvest before the rain.
items.exampleZh: 那位農夫拚命工作到筋疲力盡，趕在下雨前收成。

items.exampleEn: The fish market stinks in the afternoon heat.
items.exampleZh: 下午的炎熱讓魚市場臭氣沖天。

items.sentenceEn: Her laugh is so infectious that everyone around her starts smiling.
items.sentenceZh: 她的笑聲很有感染力，身邊的人都會跟著笑起來。

items.audioEn: I got this bruise on my arm when I walked into the door last night.
items.audioZh: 我手臂上的這塊瘀青，是昨晚撞到門弄的。
items.questionZh: 說話者怎麼弄出瘀青的？

items.sentenceEn: Scientists are studying how air pollution affects the respiratory system.
items.sentenceZh: 科學家正在研究空氣汙染如何影響呼吸系統。

items.sentenceEn: After the race, the runners lay on the grass in total exhaustion.
items.sentenceZh: 比賽結束後，跑者們筋疲力盡地躺在草地上。

items.stemEn: The trash hadn't been taken out for a week, and the whole kitchen started to ____.
items.stemZh: 垃圾一個星期都沒倒，整個廚房開始發臭了。

items.stemEn: Don't open that attachment; the file may be ____ with a virus.
items.stemZh: 別打開那個附件，檔案可能中毒了。

items.passageEn: Our school held a science fair in the main corridor last month. One group explained how the respiratory system works, using a model made of balloons. Another group showed how computer viruses spread and how to clean infected files. A third team interviewed a researcher about the history of chemotherapy and how it has improved over the years. My group's project was about sleep. We found that many students suffer from exhaustion because they stay up late. One student, a self-described phone addict, admitted he slept only five hours a night. Everyone left the fair feeling inspired.
items.passageZh: 我們學校上個月在主走廊舉辦了科學展。有一組用氣球做的模型解釋呼吸系統怎麼運作。另一組展示電腦病毒如何擴散，以及如何清除中毒的檔案。第三組訪問了一位研究人員，請教化學治療的歷史，以及這些年來有什麼改進。我這組的專題是睡眠。我們發現很多學生因為熬夜而筋疲力盡。有位自稱手機成癮的同學承認，他每晚只睡五個小時。大家離開科學展時都覺得很受啟發。

questions.questionZh: 作者那組的專題是什麼？
很多學生為什麼筋疲力盡？

items.promptZh: 香蕉很容易碰傷，所以要放在袋子最上面。
referenceEn: Bananas bruise easily, so put them on top of the bag.
Bananas bruise very easily, so they should go at the top of the bag.
rubricZh: bruise 當動詞是「碰傷」（例如 bruise easily）
「放在最上面」可寫 put them on top、at the top of the bag 等

items.instructionZh: 用 addict 造一個句子，說說你或身邊的人對某樣東西很著迷（輕鬆的話題，例如咖啡、遊戲、追劇）。
referenceEn: I'm a bit of a coffee addict, so I always start my day with a cup.
My sister is a TV addict who watches a whole series in one weekend.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 addict（例如 a coffee addict）
